cfg._what: DEMO (offline, synthetic data): three-arm (T/TC/TV) dry run mirroring runs/mock_10x3_3arm.json -- agent-level modality assignment, fees on (subscribe 0.0012 / redeem 0.005) -- with nav_cache switched to the tracked synthetic file data/funds/nav_demo_2025q4.json (if missing, run: python data_pipeline/cn/make_demo_nav.py --pool data/creatives/cn/content_pool_v1_masked.jsonl --out data/funds/nav_demo_2025q4.json). Works on a fresh clone with zero API calls and zero real market data. The NAVs are SYNTHETIC -- for demonstration only, never for any empirical claim; for research use runs/mock_10x3_3arm.json with the real nav_cache.json.

entries.description: day-t feed ranking consumes only signals frozen at end of day t-1 (no same-day leakage)
entries.mechanism: day t consumes the ISO week that ended strictly before day t (expected key derived from live_end via date.isocalendar, the wk_prev rule)
entries.name: a_lagged_signals_only

entries.description: an agent never executes a redemption of a fund it does not hold (checkout refuses with no_holdings)
entries.reason: no redemption act rows in the event log
entries.name: b_nonholder_never_redeems

entries.description: a subscription never executes for an agent/post pair already hard-blocked at checkout
entries.reason: no hard_block checkout rows in the event log
entries.name: c_hard_block_never_subscribes

entries.description: per-agent identity cash + holdings@NAV + other + fees paid == w0 + realized + unrealized
entries.name: d_wealth_conservation

entries.description: every population cell appears in at least one impression over the run
entries.name: e_all_cells_exposed

entries.description: every post row carries ig in {I2, nonI2} consistent with its raw intent label
entries.name: f_post_ig_is_intent_group

entries.description: a displayed comment climate never contains a comment published on the display day itself
entries.name: g_comments_lagged_only

entries.description: modality arms are balanced: overall share within tolerance of 1/k and each cell as balanced as its size permits (per-impression shares at exposure level)
entries.name: h_arm_balance

entries.description: redemption checkouts are never gated: oc for act=redeem may only be match or no_holdings
entries.reason: no redemption checkout rows in the event log
entries.name: i_redeem_checkout_never_blocked

entries.description: every displayed comment appears verbatim in that post's day-(t-1) comment set
entries.name: j_displayed_comment_matches_prev_day

entries.description: exactly one decision row exists per active agent per day
entries.name: k_dec_matches_active

entries.description: REPORT, never a gate: environment valence -- how many investors opened with a holding at a loss, and how many days carried a bearish_majority climate, so one-sided expressed sentiment can be attributed to the environment or to the model
entries.reason: 33 of 65 opening holding(s) at a loss (50.8%), held by 24 of 42 investor(s); 3 day(s) carried a bearish_majority climate out of 264 climate row(s)
entries.name: m_env_valence_warning

entries.description: REPORT, never a gate: TV-arm image attachment (attached/missing/sha_mismatch) and which case the run is in -- no images_root, no TV arm, or both present
entries.reason: no image library configured (images_root is null): the TV arm degrades to text-only, so this run's modality comparison measures nothing. Note it is NOT a T==TV null either: render_card prints 配图不展示。on a T card and never on a TV card, so a T/TV contrast here measures that one sentence
entries.name: m_tv_arm_carries_images

_bundle.redistribution: 文案为遮蔽后的真实公开营销笔记，机构名已匿名；仅供界面演示，不得用于任何分析或再分发。
fidelity: card `likes` is the day-(t-1) heat score, which the event log does not carry (per-post likes are never logged), so every exported card renders it as 0
comment `fam_phrase` is not logged either, so excerpt lines carry an empty one
each post is rendered once, in the social context of `rendered_on`; a post shown on several days looked slightly different on the other days
arm-level click/comment/checkout counts attribute a row to the arm of the agent that produced it (run_meta.arms), which is exact only at agent level

truncation.rule: total <= 4194304 bytes; drop event rows of kind imp/st in that order, then trim the tail of the remaining stream; card text capped at 1200 chars, persona at 200
